PDF.js 6.3.289, from the official `pdfjs-dist@6.3.289` npm package.
Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
License: Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE and the notices in the distributed files).

The legacy browser build, matching worker and viewer, CMaps, standard fonts,
image decoders (WASM), and viewer images are bundled locally for offline use.
No CDN requests or npm install are needed when running or packaging the app.
Update the renderer, worker, viewer, CSS and supporting assets together.
